Upper Text: [Security] Play this card without battling and without paying the cost. At the end of the turn, return this Digimon to your hand.

[On Play][When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less. If no Digimon was deleted by this effect, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, and that Digimon doesn't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase.
